title: Doctor Doom Authentic Comic Cuts — Master List
note: Research inventory for NLF. Not a sales catalog. Nest under Marvel Mint master set — not an isolated Doom-only DB. Jarvis owns Doom history narrative. Cut 52 is first locked ID (Fantastic Four #156). Public thumbs only; full scans stay offline research.
